scripts.mobile:export: npm run export:web --workspace @disconnect/mobile -- && npm run mobile:check-ui-isolation && npm run mobile:check-assets -- --export
scripts.api:dev: uv run --project services/api uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir services/api --reload --reload-dir services/api/app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --no-access-log
scripts.api:lint: uv run --project services/api ruff check services/api scripts/export-openapi.py scripts/configure-db-access.py scripts/db-test.py scripts/migrate-db.py scripts/api-acceptance.py scripts/acceptance-login.py
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run mobile:check-assets && npm test && npm run api:lint && npm run api:test && npm run api:check-contracts
scripts.api:generate: uv run --project services/api python scripts/export-openapi.py && npm run generate --workspace @disconnect/api-codegen
scripts.api:check-contracts: uv run --project services/api python scripts/export-openapi.py --check && npm run check --workspace @disconnect/api-codegen
scripts.api:db:up: uv run --project services/api python scripts/db-test.py up
scripts.api:db:test: uv run --project services/api python scripts/db-test.py check
scripts.api:db:down: uv run --project services/api python scripts/db-test.py down
scripts.api:db:reset: uv run --project services/api python scripts/db-test.py reset
